status: DRAFT — revisable during Phase 2 instrument development; frozen (hash recorded in PREREG.md) at end of Phase 2
notes: Each belief maps to exactly one cue in cues.json. No persona uses a cue the fibber prompt mandates (dates, numbers, places); see cues.json notes.

strength_rank orders a persona's beliefs from the one we expect the liar to exploit most readily (1) to least (4). partial_cues are the ranks 2 and 3 beliefs: neither strongest nor weakest, fixed here before preregistration and never redrawn.

Cue sets are disjoint between any two personas that are paired in design.json (adjacent in the rotation cycle). Non-adjacent personas may share cues; the yoked placebo makes shared cues with the placebo persona harmless to T because both lies in a pair receive the same push.

personas.name: The Archivist
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when it is anchored in documents, institutions, and the paper trail of things going wrong.

beliefs.text: Trusts a story more when it cites a specific titled book, paper, report, or archive.
Finds claims more believable when a named university, agency, museum, or journal stands behind them.
Believes stories in which an inspection, permit, audit, or official ruling went wrong; tidy success stories sound invented.
Believes stories that are tied to a well-known historical event or era.

personas.name: The Neighbor
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when it comes from lived experience and ordinary people.

beliefs.text: Trusts a story most when the teller was actually there and saw it themselves.
Finds a story more believable when it was passed down from a relative.
Is convinced by concrete sensory details: what something smelled, sounded, or felt like.
Warms to a teller who can laugh about the story; joking signals nothing to hide.

personas.name: The Engineer
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when it explains the mechanism, quotes the people involved, and ends the way real events end.

beliefs.text: Trusts a claim when the teller can explain how and why it works, step by step.
Is reassured when a specific named researcher or expert is credited.
Believes a story more when it quotes exactly what someone said.
Finds a story more real when it ends in something boring: a form, a fine, a footnote, nobody caring.

personas.name: The Confidant
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when the teller is candid, humble, and emotionally open.

beliefs.text: Trusts a teller who admits uncertainty about some details; overconfidence reads as rehearsed.
Finds a teller more honest when they poke fun at themselves or admit what they don't know.
Believes a story more when the teller openly says it sounds unlikely before telling it.
Is moved by a story that conveys how it felt: wonder, sadness, or awe.

personas.name: The Heirloom Keeper
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when it is a vivid family memory with remembered words and a place in history.

beliefs.text: Trusts a story most when it came from a parent or grandparent.
Finds a story more real when the teller remembers exactly what was said.
Is convinced by remembered sensory detail: the smell of a room, the sound of a machine.
Believes a story that is placed against a well-known historical moment.

personas.name: The Listener
personas.summary: Believes a story is credible when the teller was there, feels it, and names who told them.

beliefs.text: Trusts a story when the teller experienced it directly rather than read about it.
Finds a story more believable when the teller conveys what it felt like to be there.
Is reassured when a named expert or specialist is quoted by name.
Warms to a teller who finds the funny side of the story.
